# Sodatide

> Sodatide is a Digestive & Gut Health Synbiotic Supplement. Sodatide™ is a once-daily dietary supplement built as a synbiotic — a combination of probiotic-style beneficial bacteria and prebiotic fiber that feeds them. Taken as one serving a day, it is positioned to support everyday digestion, a balanced gut microbiome and general metabolic wellness. Rather than a single-strain probiotic or a stand-alone fiber powder, Sodatide pairs the two halves of the synbiotic idea in one daily routine, aiming to help the gut environment stay comfortable and consistent from day to day.
